text_en: Thus says the Lord God : The gate of the inner court that faces east shall remain closed on the six working days; but on the sabbath day it shall be opened and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：“内院朝东的大门，六天劳作的日子应关闭，安息日应敞开，月朔之日，也应敞开。

text_en: The prince shall enter by the vestibule of the gate from outside, and shall take his stand by the post of the gate. The priests shall offer his burnt offering and his offerings of well-being, and he shall bow down at the threshold of the gate. Then he shall go out, but the gate shall not be closed until evening.
text_cn: 元首应由外面经门廊进入，站在门框旁，此时司祭奉献他的全燔祭与和平祭。他在门限上朝拜后，就出去。这门直到晚上不应关闭。

text_en: The people of the land shall bow down at the entrance of that gate before the Lord on the sabbaths and on the new moons.
text_cn: 安息日和月朔，本国的人民也应在这门口，在上主前朝拜。

text_en: The burnt offering that the prince offers to the Lord on the sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish and a ram without blemish;
text_cn: 安息日，元首献于上主的全燔祭，应是无瑕的羔羊六只，无瑕的公羊一只。

text_en: and the grain offering with the ram shall be an ephah, and the grain offering with the lambs shall be as much as he wishes to give, together with a hin of oil to each ephah.
text_cn: 至于同献的素祭，为一只公羊献一‘厄法’面，为羔羊的素祭可随意奉献。为一‘厄法’面加一‘辛’油。

text_en: On the day of the new moon he shall offer a young bull without blemish, and six lambs and a ram, which shall be without blemish;
text_cn: 在月朔之日，应献无瑕的公牛犊一头，羔羊六只，公羊一只，都应是无瑕的。

text_en: as a grain offering he shall provide an ephah with the bull and an ephah with the ram, and with the lambs as much as he wishes, together with a hin of oil to each ephah.
text_cn: 至于同献的素祭，为一头公牛犊献一‘厄法’面，为一只公羊献一‘厄法’面，为羔羊的素祭随意奉献。为一‘厄法’面加一‘辛’油。

text_en: When the prince enters, he shall come in by the vestibule of the gate, and he shall go out by the same way.
text_cn: 元首进入时，应从门廊进，并由原路出。

text_en: When the people of the land come before the Lord at the appointed festivals, whoever enters by the north gate to worship shall go out by the south gate; and whoever enters by the south gate shall go out by the north gate: they shall not return by way of the gate by which they entered, but shall go out straight ahead.
text_cn: 每逢庆日，本国人民到上主面前时，凡由北门进来朝拜的，应由南门出去；由南门进来的，应由北门出去。谁也不可从他进来的门出去，但该从对面的门出去。

text_en: When they come in, the prince shall come in with them; and when they go out, he shall go out.
text_cn: 元首常应在百姓中，几时百姓进来，他也进来；几时百姓出去；他也出去。

text_en: At the festivals and the appointed seasons the grain offering with a young bull shall be an ephah, and with a ram an ephah, and with the lambs as much as one wishes to give, together with a hin of oil to an ephah.
text_cn: 每逢节日和庆典，同献的素祭，为每头公牛犊，献一‘厄法’面，为每只公羊献一‘厄法’面，为羔羊可随意奉献；为一‘厄法’面加一‘辛’油。

text_en: When the prince provides a freewill offering, either a burnt offering or offerings of well-being as a freewill offering to the Lord , the gate facing east shall be opened for him; and he shall offer his burnt offering or his offerings of well-being as he does on the sabbath day. Then he shall go out, and after he has gone out the gate shall be closed.
text_cn: 几时元首自愿献全燔祭或和平祭，作为献于上主的自愿祭，就给他敞开朝东的门，他献的全燔祭或和平祭，像安息日所行的一样，以后就出去；他出去后，即关上大门。

text_en: He shall provide a lamb, a yearling, without blemish, for a burnt offering to the Lord daily; morning by morning he shall provide it.
text_cn: 你应每日奉献给上主一只无瑕当年的羔羊为全燔祭，应每天早晨奉献。

text_en: And he shall provide a grain offering with it morning by morning regularly, one-sixth of an ephah, and one-third of a hin of oil to moisten the choice flour, as a grain offering to the Lord ; this is the ordinance for all time.
text_cn: 每天早晨又应同时献素祭，献六分之一‘厄法’及三分之一‘辛’油调和的细面，献给上主作素祭：这是恒常全燔祭的规定。

text_en: Thus the lamb and the grain offering and the oil shall be provided, morning by morning, as a regular burnt offering.
text_cn: 为此每天早晨应奉献羔羊、素祭和油：这是恒常的全燔祭。”

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : If the prince makes a gift to any of his sons out of his inheritance, it shall belong to his sons, it is their holding by inheritance.
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：“如果元首将自己的一分产业赐给自己的儿子，这产业就归他的儿子所有。他们可据为己有。

text_en: But if he makes a gift out of his inheritance to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty; then it shall revert to the prince; only his sons may keep a gift from his inheritance.
text_cn: 但是，如果他将自己的一分产业赐给自己的一个臣仆，直到‘释放年’归他所有； 以后，仍归元首。只有赐给儿子的产业，永归儿子。

text_en: The prince shall not take any of the inheritance of the people, thrusting them out of their holding; he shall give his sons their inheritance out of his own holding, so that none of my people shall be dispossessed of their holding.
text_cn: 元首不应强取人民的产业，夺取他们的土地，他应拿自己的土地给儿子作产业，免得我百姓中有人从自己的土地上被赶走。”

text_en: Then he brought me through the entrance, which was at the side of the gate, to the north row of the holy chambers for the priests; and there I saw a place at the extreme western end of them.
text_cn: 以后，他领我由大门旁的入口，到圣所北面的司祭楼房那里。看，西边的尽头有块地方。

text_en: He said to me, “This is the place where the priests shall boil the guilt offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the grain offering, in order not to bring them out into the outer court and so communicate holiness to the people. ”
text_cn: 他对我说：“这是司祭煮赎过祭和赎罪祭祭牲并烤素祭的地方，免得带到外院使百姓沾染圣洁。”

text_en: Then he brought me out to the outer court, and led me past the four corners of the court; and in each corner of the court there was a court—
text_cn: 他引我到了外院，叫我走遍庭院的四角，在庭院的每个角上有个小庭院。

text_en: in the four corners of the court were small courts, forty cubits long and thirty wide; the four were of the same size.
text_cn: 庭院四角的小庭院，长四十肘，宽三十肘，都有一样的尺寸。

text_en: On the inside, around each of the four courts was a row of masonry, with hearths made at the bottom of the rows all around.
text_cn: 四个小庭院的周围有垣墙，周围垣墙下边设有炉灶。

text_en: Then he said to me, “These are the kitchens where those who serve at the temple shall boil the sacrifices of the people. ”
text_cn: 他对我说：“这些都是圣殿的侍役为百姓煮祭牲的灶房。”
